learning_outcomes.text: Model logic circuits using Boolean Algebra.
Analyze, simplify and design combinational and sequential logic circuits.
Design and use complex modules (adders, decoders, multiplexers) for designing combinational circuits.
Design multi-functional registers and simple RAMs.
Model simple digital circuits using Hardware Description Language (Verilog).
Apply Boolean Algebra to simplify Boolean expressions.
Design combinational logic circuits built from standard logic gates.
Combine elementary logic units to create advanced digital circuits.
Design digital circuits using decoders and multiplexers.
Design sequential logic using standard logic gates and memory elements.
Design multi-functional registers using memory elements.

syllabus_topics: Karnaugh maps (two, three, four and five variables)
Design of combinational circuits using primitive gates
Design of combinational circuits using multiplexers and decoders
Design of sequential circuits and finite state machines
Design of registers and static memories
teaching_methods: Use of projector and interactive board during lectures
Announcement of assessment marks via the ecourse platform by UOI
Use of email and social media for information exchange and improved communication
assessment_rules: The final examination includes problem solving and is evaluated based on the correctness and completeness of answers. There is also a separate laboratory examination. The specific weighting of these components is not provided.
